li.label: humiliated by captors
li.description: They degraded me for their own amusement. The shame sits heavy in my chest.

li.label: sold like cattle
li.description: I was sold to new owners like an animal. I am nothing to anyone now.

li.label: free at last
li.description: I am out of their hands. Whatever comes next, I face it on my own feet.

li.label: they took a piece of me
li.description: The captors cut a spare organ out of me and sold it. To them I am worth more in pieces than whole.

li.label: beaten by captors
li.description: The captors beat me because they can. My body aches and I feel powerless to stop them.
